def analyze(tables: dict) -> object:
    df = tables['orders'].copy()
    df = df
    df['order_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['order_date'], format='mixed')
    _df_curr = df[(df['order_date'] >= pd.Timestamp('2025-04-01')) & (df['order_date'] <= pd.Timestamp('2025-06-30'))]
    _df_prior = df[(df['order_date'] >= pd.Timestamp('2024-04-01')) & (df['order_date'] <= pd.Timestamp('2024-06-30'))]
    _curr = _df_curr.groupby(['category'], observed=True)['revenue'].sum()
    _prior = _df_prior.groupby(['category'], observed=True)['revenue'].sum()
    _prior = _prior.reindex(_curr.index)
    _agg = (_curr - _prior) / _prior.abs()
    _agg = _agg.dropna()
    _agg = _agg.sort_values(ascending=False)
    result = _agg.index[0]
    return result

    df = tables['tickets'].copy()
    df = df
    df['created_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['created_date'], format='mixed')

    _df_prior = df[(df['created_date'] >= pd.Timestamp('2024-04-01')) & (df['created_date'] <= pd.Timestamp('2024-06-30'))]

    _agg = _agg.sort_values(ascending=False)
    result = _agg.index[0]
    return result
